method: For each Act, 14 sections (10 fixed: lettered and frequently cited; 4 drawn with random.Random(20261112)) were located in the official India Code PDF of the Act, the region of the page with the section head was rendered to an image, and the image was compared by eye with the CSV heading (2026-11-12). The BNSS sample uses the English India Code PDF (A2023-46.pdf). Evidence Act 66 was re-rendered on its own because the first render showed section 166.
reviewer: Claude Code (assistant), UNREVIEWED by a person
